messages:
sara: Quick sync — compact sprint status: Optimize toolkit quant recs + batching/caching suggestions. Milestone end Wed. Any blockers?
aj: I’m owning the quant rollout. PR mostly ready but CI flagged a perf regression on long sequences.
miho: I saw that too. p50 went 98ms -> 102ms on the long-seq harness after the quant export. Seems related to KV cache invalidation after shard reordering.
aj: failing test snippet:```
E   AssertionError: p50 latency increased > threshold
logs: kv_cache_miss_count=342 -> 1289
```
aj: PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4021 if anyone wants to review.
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline: canary pipeline queued (canary/gpus-a). Triggered by @aj. ETA ~ 20m.
ryan: @aj can you add a short comparison run with `--quant-mode per_channel` so we can see if per-tensor quantization is the culprit?
miho: Good idea. Also I'd prefer prefix caching OFF for the canary to avoid masking the KV invalidation behavior.
sara: Agreed — keep prefix caching off. Ownership: @aj -> quant rollout, @miho -> perf investigation, @ryan -> deployment gating. Timeline: aim for canary today 19:00 UTC, full rollout Thu morning if green.
devon: Heads up — we'll need a small batching config tweak for canary. In `configs/production/batching.yaml` bump `max_batch_size` to 8 for gpus-a smoke runs. I'll prepare a tiny PR.
miho: On regression alerting: add a smoke eval check in `evals/regression/optkit/latency.yaml` to alert if p50 > 110ms or error rate > 0.5%. Don't want surprises.
aj: I'll wire the alert and run the smoke harness after the canary.
ryan: Note: scheduled infra maintenance at 22:00 UTC tonight overlaps the original window. I'll shift the canary to 19:00 to avoid it. Will gate final rollout if maintenance causes instability.
devon: I'll add a one-line note to the release blurb about quantization changes and the canary config.
sara: Quick Q: do we want to enable the new KV soft-eviction during canary? That could hide issues.
miho: Recommend NO for canary. Keep runtime behavior as close to prod as possible except the quant changes.
aj: Acknowledged. Can run an additional run with soft-eviction ON after canary for comparison.
ops-bot: Reminder: canary pipeline queued -> pipeline id `canary-202403-19`.
ryan: I'll watch the pipeline, gating criteria: p50 <= 110ms, error_rate <= 0.5%, and no >3% tail regressions on 95/99.
sara: Perfect. Final: canary 19:00 UTC today, owners as stated. Ping this thread with results and link to canary run. :thumbsup:
